title: Clean New Clothes
old_p1: The Lord showed Zechariah Joshua, the high priest. A high priest led the work in the Lord’s house.
Joshua stood before an angel in dirty clothes. The dirty clothes were a picture of wrong things he had done.
The angel said, “Take away the dirty clothes.” He told Joshua, “I have taken your wrong things away.” Then they dressed him in clean clothes!
old_p2: The Lord promised to send “the Branch.” A branch is new growth on a tree. Jesus would come from King David’s family, like a new branch. The Branch is Jesus!
When we are sorry, Jesus helps us feel clean and new inside. He can do that for you too, like fresh new clothes.
p1: The Lord showed Zechariah a picture. Joshua, the leader of the priests at the Lord’s house, stood before an angel.
Joshua’s clothes were dirty, a picture of the wrong things he had done.
“Take away the dirty clothes,” the angel said. He told Joshua, “I have taken your wrong things away.” They dressed him in clean clothes and a clean hat!
p2: Then the Lord promised to send “the Branch.” A branch is new green growth from an old tree. Jesus would come from King David’s family, like a new branch. The Branch is Jesus!
When we are sorry, Jesus makes us clean and new inside. Tonight, tell Heavenly Father one thing you are sorry for. Then feel brand new!
